dict.Angajatorul plătește primele 5 zile cale: The employer pays the first 5 calendar days (only the working days among them count); the rest is recovered from the health insurance fund (FNUASS). For “Continuation” certificates and for the codes marked “No”, FNUASS pays everything.
dict.Certificatele de concediu medical ale an: Employees' sick leave certificates: from the benefit code, the period and the average daily income you get the working days, the percentage (for ordinary illness, by the length of the leave), the benefit and how it is split: days 1–5 from the employer, the rest from the health insurance fund (FNUASS), to be recovered; the percentages sit in an editable table on the right.
dict.La boala obișnuită procentul se ia după: For ordinary illness the percentage follows the calendar days of the certificate; for a continuation certificate you can type the percentage for the total length directly. The percentages (in yellow) change by law: check them with your accountant.
dict.Media zilnică: veniturile brute din ulti: Daily average: the gross income of the last 6 months (at most 12 minimum wages per month) divided by the working days in those months.
